why: `release` runs the tagged commit, so the fixed publish workflow must exist before v2 is cut; a prerelease or lower 2.x must never take `latest`; 2.8.0 shipped on a red master.
what: .github/workflows/{publish,release,ci,deploy}.yml, scripts/release.sh library half (new dist_tag_for, CI-green preflight, no-package-commit refusal, per-tag await_registry) and scripts/release.test.ts. version_gate, BRANCH and the dispatch flow stay untouched: the old gate must still accept 2.29.1. v3-charts-bump files --after this Issue (shared bun.lock).
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 4.1 step 1, 4.3 and docs/v3/evidence/gap-repo-surface-release-proof.md 2.3, 2.5, 2.6 (tag step, preflight query). dist_tag_for <version> <registry_latest>: version is X.Y.Z or X.Y.Z-pre, registry_latest is X.Y.Z or empty, anything else exits 1. Prerelease: next. Empty or version >= registry_latest (sort -V): latest. Else latest-<major>. Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so. Frozen contracts are read-only.
change: (1) dist_tag_for in the library half, sourced by publish.yml: version from package.json, an `echo "dist-tag=$DIST_TAG"` line, then `npm publish --access public --tag "$DIST_TAG"`; drop the GITHUB_REF_NAME derivation. (2) CI-green preflight: the newest non-release first-parent commit's CI run must be completed/success. After the dry run, refuse when `git log <last v* tag>..origin/master -- packages/basalt-ui` is empty (the dropped path filter's replacement). (3) await_registry polls `npm view --prefer-online basalt-ui@<dist-tag> version`. (4) release.yml: plain ./node_modules/.bin/semantic-release; drop `node -r`, MONOREPO_DIR and semantic-release-monorepo (root package.json, bun.lock). (5) ci.yml: fetch-depth 0 and commitlint over the range: pull_request `--from <base.sha> --to <head.sha>`; push `--from <event.before> --to <sha>`, and for a new-branch push (before is 40 zeros) `--from origin/master --to HEAD`. (6) deploy.yml: push paths ['apps/marketing/**','.github/workflows/deploy.yml'] plus workflow_dispatch; rewrite only the 'Every master push' comment paragraph. Tests in release.test.ts; no lint rule or skill snippet.
commits: One PR, `ci:` commits, non-package only (no isolation split). No attribution.
proof: bun test scripts/release.test.ts; ci.yml green on the PR. Reviewed deep.
acceptance: bun test scripts/release.test.ts passes: the table above, a stubbed gh refusing a non-success run, the no-package-commit refusal, and every existing version_gate case unchanged.

grep -rnE 'semantic-release-monorepo|node -r|MONOREPO_DIR' .github package.json bun.lock returns nothing; bun install --frozen-lockfile exits 0.
ci.yml has fetch-depth: 0 and the commitlint --from/--to forms; deploy.yml has the paths filter and workflow_dispatch.
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD shows nothing under packages/basalt-ui/ or .releaserc.json.
